discovery_notes: Cell B310, follow-up 3 of B015 (packets 215, 422, 464); reuses their keys. 29 standard searches, snippets only. New productive sources: Disney Magical Kingdom Blog and Hong Kong Main Street Gazette (Chinese fan blogs relaying HKDL monthly LE announcements with dates, sizes, some HK$ prices). New pins: HKDL Father's Day Pinocchio, Dwarfs carousel, Mother's Day, Mystic Manor 5th, Chip & Dale 75th, Teachers' Day, Tsum Tsum Fun Fair LE/MA, 13th anniversary MA; TDR Oct 2018 Splash Mountain and Tower of Terror. Hold released: hkdl/2018/carousel-series/stitch (held in 464) on DMK dated per-pin post. Food game pins held (prize list). Resellers (usshoppingsos, carousell, wickedpins, belloshophk) and YouTube ignored.
